failure_summary.description: Some calls used a neighboring or generic endpoint, or a different provider, instead of the endpoint matching the requested operation and result.
Call sets omitted requested outcomes and/or included unrelated or repeated calls.
Arguments included incorrect or missing values, unsupported placeholders, or malformed parameter objects and JSON.

patch.reasoning: These patterns are already explicitly covered by the skill's endpoint-eligibility gate, outcome checklist, smallest-complete-call-set rules, schema mapping, and final JSON audit. The observed failures are primarily failures to follow those instructions, so adding overlapping guidance would duplicate existing content.
